description: This file defines classes and templates for Ethernet and IP frame processing, including Ethernet frames, IPv4 frames, TCP, UDP, and their respective headers, with methods for loading, validating, and manipulating network packet data.

classes.name: EthernetFrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an Ethernet frame with methods to load data, access MAC addresses, and check broadcast MAC.

classes.name: IPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPv4 packet, providing methods to access and modify IP header fields, validate checksum, and load data.

classes.name: TCPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class for TCP over IPv4 frames, allowing access to TCP header fields and data loading.

classes.name: UDPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class for UDP over IPv4 frames, with methods for checksum validation, source/destination ports, and data loading.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads data into the frame buffer, copying from a provided buffer.

methods.name: SourceMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the source MAC address in Ethernet frame.

methods.name: DestinationMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination MAC address in Ethernet frame.

methods.name: IsBroadcastMAC
methods.description: Checks if a given MAC address is a broadcast address.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Gets or sets the source IP address in IPv4 frame.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination IP address in IPv4 frame.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live field in IPv4 header.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Gets or sets the total length of the IP packet or transport layer segment.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the IP packet.

methods.name: Protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol field from the IP header.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for IP or UDP headers.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the IP header checksum and protocol.

methods.name: SourcePort
methods.description: Gets or sets the source port in UDP or TCP headers.

methods.name: DestinationPort
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination port in UDP or TCP headers.

methods.name: Frame
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the payload data after headers.
